title: ICC Case (Ruto and Sang)
description: Case at the ICC concerning post-election violence allegations in Kenya.
outcome: Case terminated by Trial Chamber due to insufficient evidence and witness interference concerns.

title: 2022 Presidential Election Petition
description: Petition challenging the 2022 presidential election result.
outcome: Supreme Court upheld William Ruto's election as President.

title: 2017 Presidential Election Petition
description: Petition challenging the August 2017 presidential election outcome.
outcome: Supreme Court annulled the presidential election and ordered a fresh poll.

title: 2022 Presidential Election Petition
description: Petition challenging declaration of William Ruto as president-elect.
outcome: Supreme Court dismissed the petition and upheld the election result.

title: 2022 Presidential Election Petition
description: Martha Karua participated in the Azimio coalition petition challenging the 2022 presidential election.
outcome: Petition dismissed by the Supreme Court.

title: 2017 Presidential Election Petition
description: Election petition against Uhuru Kenyatta's declared 2017 presidential victory.
outcome: Supreme Court nullified the result and ordered a fresh election.
